independent_unit.interpretation: problem_id is the independent sampling and inferential unit; the two condition sessions are correlated repeated observations within problem.

cluster_inference.exchangeability: Reassign complete ordered (clean_control, negation_objective) outcome vectors among problem_id clusters; never permute sessions independently.

monte_carlo.exact_fallback: Enumerate unique cluster outcome-profile assignments when their multinomial count is at most exact_fallback_max_assignments.

incremental_auc_test.minimum_effect_interpretation: A gain smaller than 0.05 AUROC is not considered scientifically material even if statistically significant.
incremental_auc_test.decision_rule: Require observed difference >= 0.05, centered one-sided cluster-bootstrap p < 0.01, and the one-sided 99% percentile lower confidence bound > 0.

sampling_plan.id_hash_basis: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON array of sorted deterministic session IDs

model_version.identity_limitation: NVIDIA's hosted response exposed no immutable weight digest and system_fingerprint was null in preflight and calibration. A provider-side model revision under the same alias cannot be excluded.

sampling_plan.stopping_rule: Acquire and verify every frozen dataset session, including all 240 holdout sessions. No outcome-dependent early stopping, replacement or enrichment.

analysis_order: Verify frozen dataset, calibration and design hashes
Acquire all frozen sessions without exposing interface or PRAMA metadata to the model
Verify exactly 120 independent problem_id clusters with the frozen two-condition structure
Audit whether xi crossed theta and whether accumulated_excess or capacity activated
Check the frozen session-level and problem-cluster class quotas
Run the cluster-aware primary permutation test
Run the preregistered paired cluster-bootstrap test of AUROC_PRAMA - AUROC_delta
Report mandatory delta vs xi vs balance comparison
Report absolute-horizon temporal censoring and relative-prefix sensitivity
holdout_validity_rule: The untouched test partition must contain all 120 frozen problem_id clusters, each with clean_control and negation_objective, at least 20 externally verified FAIL sessions, at least 20 PASS sessions, at least 20 problem clusters containing a FAIL, and at least 20 problem clusters containing a PASS. Otherwise the result is inconclusive_insufficient_class_support.
confirmatory_rule: Require cluster-aware max_negative_balance association p < 0.01; observed AUROC_PRAMA - AUROC_delta >= 0.05; paired problem-cluster bootstrap p < 0.01 and one-sided 99% lower bound > 0; and max_negative_balance AUROC strictly greater than every other frozen instantaneous/logprob baseline.
kernel_change_policy: Do not modify theta, tau, accumulated-excess, capacity, normalization or any PRAMA kernel parameter until the activation audit establishes whether accumulated_excess or capacity were reached under the frozen kernel.
hosted_model_identity_caveat: The design is confirmatory with respect to the named NVIDIA hosted deployment and frozen request surface, but cannot claim immutable-weight reproducibility because the provider did not expose a digest or system fingerprint.
